items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jeter and Hayes and who would have been playing piano? Wasn't that this little guy, this Peanuts? Was Peanuts working with you then? [INTERVIEWEE] We called him Surf.
